name: zsnd_play_handle_try_disable_managed
description: zSndPlayHandle_TryDisableManaged clears the active flag only on active handles.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for @zSndPlayHandle_TryDisableManaged@4 at 0x4a1270 passed with zero unmasked mismatches after masking 0 COFF relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 24 bytes and the VC object symbol is 32 bytes with 8 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4a1270 returns 0 for null or inactive handles, writes isActive = 0 for active handles, and returns 1 only when it changed the handle.
The native smoke verifies null, inactive, active-clear, and repeated-disable behavior.
